title: CVS Refill Failure Rate
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cvs:refill
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(refill_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by drug_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often CVS refill records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each drug.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize refill_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per drug.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which parts of your CVS refill data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
